title: MANTL In-Branch Account Opening Emerges as the Platform's Top Growth Channel in 2026
summary: Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) ("Alkami"), a digital sales and service platform provider for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that in-branch account opening has become MANTL's highest-volume growth channel in 2026. In-branch application volume achieved record levels in 2026, reaching nearly 90,000 booked applications in a single month, and bringing total in-branch applications booked through MANTL to more than 1 million to date.

title: Alkami to Host Webinar on How Financial Wellness Can be a Strategic Growth Initiative
summary: Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) ("Alkami"), a digital sales and service platform provider for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced it will host a webinar exploring how financial wellness can help banks and credit unions strengthen relationships, increase engagement and retention, and drive long-term growth. The webinar, "More Than a Feature: Financial Wellness as a Growth Strategy," will take place on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. EDT.

title: Embers Credit Union is Live with MANTL Loan Origination
summary: Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) ("Alkami"), a digital sales and service platform provider for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that Embers Credit Union (Embers), a Marquette, Michigan-based credit union, is live with MANTL Loan Origination. The launch supports Embers' goals of increasing lending automation, improving operational efficiency, and delivering a more streamlined experience for borrowers and loan officers.
